bulkImport.title: Import saved enemies backup
bulkImport.copy: Load a JSON file exported from selected saved enemies. Matching ids update existing saved enemies and new ids are inserted ahead of the untouched local ones.

dropzone.title: Drop the saved enemies JSON here
dropzone.subtitle: Or click to choose an exported backup file.

stats.duplicates: Collapsed {{count}} duplicate ids from the import.

errors.invalidJson: The selected file is not valid JSON.
errors.invalidPayload: The selected file does not match the saved enemies import schema.
errors.unsupportedSchema: This saved enemies import schema is not supported.

editor.copy: Save only enemy-related filters so Auto Team Builder can reopen them later.

paste.title: Paste enemy text
paste.copy: Paste raw mechanics and counter notes, parse them locally, and replace the current mechanic/counter draft only after you press apply.
paste.label: Enemy mechanics and counter text
paste.placeholder: Paste lines like: 4 turn(s) Special Bind, 4 turn(s) Paralysis, Non-Normal Attacks deal 1 damage

selection.title: Select parsed ability filters
selection.copy: Review the matched abilities by category and choose only the filters that should be required for this enemy.
selection.emptyCategory: No parsed abilities were matched for this category.

image.copy: Upload a local enemy image or choose an OPTC character portrait for preview only on the saved enemies page.

errors.characterLoadFailed: The selected character image could not be loaded.
errors.invalidType: Choose an image file from your computer.
errors.loadFailed: The image could not be loaded.

picker.copy: Browse the local OPTC character catalog and use one portrait as the enemy image snapshot.
picker.title: Choose character portrait

image.title: Enemy image

editor.noAbilityCatalog: Ability catalog is not available in this dataset yet.

enemyMechanics.title: Enemy mechanics
enemyMechanics.copy: Store the full enemy behavior here first. Direct counters will be derived automatically where possible.

derivedCounters.title: Derived counters
derivedCounters.copy: These counters are generated automatically from the selected enemy mechanics.
derivedCounters.empty: No direct counters are derived from the current mechanics.

manualCounters.title: Manual counter overrides
manualCounters.copy: Add extra direct counters only when the enemy needs coverage beyond the structured mechanics list.

specialFilters.title: Special filters
specialFilters.copy: Choose the Special effects needed for this enemy. Builder and character results must match every selected effect.

crewmateFilters.title: Crewmate Ability filters
crewmateFilters.copy: Pick Crewmate effects. Results must cover every selected effect.

potentialFilters.title: Potential Ability filters
potentialFilters.copy: Pick Potential effects. Results must cover every selected effect.

toggles.classes: Require all selected classes per slot
toggles.classesCopy: Keep every slot aligned with the saved class rules.
toggles.typesCopy: Keep every selected type represented in the result.

supportFilters.title: Support Ability filters
supportFilters.copy: Pick Support effects. Results must cover every selected effect.

empty.copy: Create a saved enemy preset, then reopen it in Auto Team Builder with all enemy filters prefilled.
empty.title: No saved enemies yet.

hero.copy: Saved enemies let you keep boss requirements separately from your manual team strategy.
hero.title: Build reusable enemy presets and send them straight into Auto Team Builder.
